23	    for f in srcs.srcs:
24	      all_srcs.append(f)

28	  for f in all_srcs:
29	    zipper_args.append(f.path)

31	  # Run zip command.
32	  ctx.actions.run(
33	    inputs = all_srcs,
34	    outputs = [ctx.outputs.zip],
35	    executable = ctx.executable._zipper,
36	    arguments = zipper_args,
37	    progress_message = "Creating zip...",

25	# Number of CPUs reserved per Verilate action in Bazel's local scheduler.
26	# Sourced from `nproc` at workspace-fetch time so we don't oversubscribe
27	# small hosts (a hardcoded 8 was blocking 6-core boxes from scheduling

31	def _verilator_resource_estimator(os, input_size):
32	    # Cap the scheduler reservation at 4 so multiple actions can still run
33	    # in parallel on larger hosts; the `make -j` inside the action is free
34	    # to use more threads if the scheduler hands them over.
35	    return {"cpu": min(_verilator_make_parallelism, 4), "memory": 4096}

37	def _verilator_cocotb_model_impl(ctx):
38	    hdl_toplevel = ctx.attr.hdl_toplevel
39	    outdir_name = hdl_toplevel + "_build"
40	
41	    cc_toolchain = find_cc_toolchain(ctx)
42	    compiler_executable = cc_toolchain.compiler_executable
43	    ar_executable = cc_toolchain.ar_executable
44	    ld_executable = cc_toolchain.ld_executable
45	
46	    # Collect DPI/C++ dependencies
47	    dpi_srcs_dict = {}
48	    dpi_includes = []
49	    dpi_files_dict = {}
50	    verilog_srcs = []
51	
52	    def add_dpi_src(f):
53	        if type(f) == "File" and f.extension in ["cc", "cpp", "cxx", "c", "a", "o"]:
54	            dpi_srcs_dict[f.path] = "$PWD/" + f.path
55	            dpi_files_dict[f.path] = f
56	
57	    def add_dpi_file(f):
58	        if type(f) == "File":
59	            dpi_files_dict[f.path] = f
60	
61	    # We need to collect CC sources transitively
62	    for dep in ctx.attr.deps:
63	        if CcInfo in dep:
64	            cc_info = dep[CcInfo]
65	
66	            # Transitive includes
67	            for inc in cc_info.compilation_context.includes.to_list():
68	                dpi_includes.append("-I" + inc)
69	            for inc in cc_info.compilation_context.quote_includes.to_list():
70	                dpi_includes.append("-I" + inc)
71	            for inc in cc_info.compilation_context.system_includes.to_list():
72	                dpi_includes.append("-I" + inc)
73	
74	            # Transitive headers
75	            for f in cc_info.compilation_context.headers.to_list():
76	                add_dpi_file(f)
77	
78	            # Transitive sources
79	            # Bazel rules often put sources in DefaultInfo
80	            for f in dep[DefaultInfo].files.to_list():
81	                add_dpi_src(f)
82	                if f.extension in ["h", "hh", "hpp"]:
83	                    add_dpi_file(f)
84	
85	            # Check transitive linker inputs for sources that might be hidden
86	            # This is necessary for targets that don't have sources in DefaultInfo
87	            for li in cc_info.linking_context.linker_inputs.to_list():
88	                for lib in li.libraries:
89	                    if lib.static_library:
90	                        add_dpi_file(lib.static_library)
91	                    if lib.pic_static_library:
92	                        add_dpi_file(lib.pic_static_library)
93	                    if lib.objects:
94	                        for obj in lib.objects:
95	                            add_dpi_file(obj)
96	
97	        if VerilogInfo in dep:
98	            verilog_srcs.append(dep[VerilogInfo].dag)
99	
100	    # Collect all input files for the action and their paths
101	    all_inputs_dict = {}
102	    verilog_paths = []
103	
104	    def add_input(f):
105	        if type(f) == "File":
106	            all_inputs_dict[f.path] = f
107	            return True
108	        return False
109	
110	    for f in dpi_files_dict.values():
111	        add_input(f)
112	
113	    # Process verilog sources collected from deps and direct attributes
114	    for f in verilog_srcs:
115	        if type(f) == "File":
116	            if add_input(f):
117	                verilog_paths.append(f.path)
118	        elif hasattr(f, "to_list"):  # It's a depset from VerilogInfo.dag
119	            for node in f.to_list():
120	                for s in node.srcs:
121	                    if add_input(s):
122	                        verilog_paths.append(s.path)
123	
124	    if ctx.attr.verilog_source:
125	        f = ctx.file.verilog_source
126	        add_input(f)
127	        verilog_paths.append(f.path)
128	
129	    for f in ctx.files.verilog_sources:
130	        add_input(f)
131	        verilog_paths.append(f.path)
132	
133	    vlt_file = ctx.actions.declare_file(hdl_toplevel + ".vlt")
134	    ctx.actions.expand_template(
135	        output = vlt_file,
136	        template = ctx.file.vlt_tpl,
137	        substitutions = {"{HDL_TOPLEVEL}": hdl_toplevel},
138	    )
139	    add_input(vlt_file)
140	
141	    output_file = ctx.actions.declare_file(outdir_name + "/" + hdl_toplevel)
142	    make_log = ctx.actions.declare_file(outdir_name + "/make.log")
143	    outdir = output_file.dirname
144	
145	    verilator_root = "$PWD/{}.runfiles/coralnpu_hw/external/verilator".format(ctx.executable._verilator_bin.path)
146	    cocotb_lib_path = "$PWD/{}".format(ctx.files._cocotb_verilator_lib[0].dirname)
147	
148	    # Prepend $PWD to paths for verilator to find them in the sandbox
149	    verilog_sources_str = " ".join(["$PWD/" + p if not p.startswith("/") else p for p in verilog_paths])
150	
151	    verilator_cmd = " ".join("""
152	        VERILATOR_ROOT={verilator_root} {verilator} \
153	            -cc \
154	            --exe \
155	            -Mdir {outdir} \
156	            --top-module {hdl_toplevel} \
157	            --vpi \
158	            --prefix Vtop \
159	            -o {hdl_toplevel} \
160	            -LDFLAGS "-Wl,-rpath {cocotb_lib_path} -L{cocotb_lib_path} -lcocotbvpi_verilator" \
161	            {trace} \
162	            {cflags} \
163	            -I. -Ihdl/verilog {dpi_includes} \
164	            $PWD/{verilator_cpp} \
165	            $PWD/{vlt_file} \
166	            {dpi_srcs} \
167	            {verilog_sources}
168	    """.strip().split("\n")).format(
169	        verilator = ctx.executable._verilator_bin.path,
170	        verilator_root = verilator_root,
171	        outdir = outdir,
172	        hdl_toplevel = hdl_toplevel,
173	        cocotb_lib_path = cocotb_lib_path,
174	        cflags = " ".join(ctx.attr.cflags),
175	        dpi_includes = " ".join({inc: None for inc in dpi_includes}.keys()),  # Unique includes
176	        verilator_cpp = ctx.files._cocotb_verilator_cpp[0].path,
177	        vlt_file = vlt_file.path,
178	        dpi_srcs = " ".join(dpi_srcs_dict.values()),
179	        verilog_sources = verilog_sources_str,
180	        trace = "--trace" if ctx.attr.trace else "",
181	    )
182	
183	    make_cmd = "PATH=`dirname {ld}`:$PATH make -j {parallelism} -C {outdir} -f Vtop.mk {trace} CXX={cxx} AR={ar} LINK={cxx} > {make_log} 2>&1".format(
184	        outdir = outdir,
185	        cocotb_lib_path = cocotb_lib_path,
186	        make_log = make_log.path,
187	        trace = "VM_TRACE=1" if ctx.attr.trace else "",
188	        ar = ar_executable,
189	        ld = ld_executable,
190	        cxx = compiler_executable,
191	        parallelism = _verilator_make_parallelism,
192	    )
193	
194	    script = " && ".join([verilator_cmd.strip(), make_cmd])
195	
196	    ctx.actions.run_shell(
197	        outputs = [output_file, make_log],
198	        tools = ctx.files._verilator_bin,
199	        inputs = depset(
200	            [f for f in all_inputs_dict.values()],
201	            transitive = [
202	                depset(ctx.files._verilator),
203	                depset(ctx.files._cocotb_verilator_lib),
204	                depset(ctx.files._cocotb_verilator_cpp),
205	            ],
206	        ),
207	        command = script,
208	        mnemonic = "Verilate",
209	        resource_set = _verilator_resource_estimator,
210	    )
211	
212	    return [
213	        DefaultInfo(
214	            files = depset([output_file, make_log]),
215	            runfiles = ctx.runfiles(files = [output_file, make_log]),
216	            executable = output_file,
217	        ),
218	        OutputGroupInfo(
219	            all_files = depset([output_file, make_log]),
220	        ),
221	    ]

334	def _verilator_cocotb_test_suite(
335	        name,
336	        model,
337	        testcases = [],
338	        testcases_vname = "",
339	        tests_kwargs = {},
340	        **kwargs):
341	    """Runs a cocotb test with a verilator model.
342	
343	    This is a wrapper around the cocotb_test rule that is specific to
344	    verilator.
345	
346	    Args:
347	        name: The name of the test.
348	        model: The verilator_cocotb_model target to use.
349	        testcases: A list of testcases to run. A test will be generated for each
350	          testcase.
351	        tests_kwargs: A dictionary of arguments to pass to the cocotb_test rule.
352	        **kwargs: Additional arguments to pass to the cocotb_test rule.
353	    """
354	    all_tests_kwargs = dict(tests_kwargs)
355	    all_tests_kwargs.update(kwargs)
356	
357	    default_tc_size = all_tests_kwargs.pop("default_testcase_size", "")
358	
359	    if testcases:
360	        test_targets = []
361	        for tc in testcases:
362	            tc_size = default_tc_size
363	            if type(tc) == "tuple":
364	                tc, tc_size = tc
365	
366	            tc_tests_kwargs = dict(all_tests_kwargs)
367	            if tc_size:
368	                tc_tests_kwargs.update({"size": tc_size})
369	                tc_tests_kwargs.pop("timeout", "")
370	            tags = list(tc_tests_kwargs.pop("tags", []))
371	            tags.append("verilator_cocotb_single_test")
372	            verilator_cocotb_test(
373	                name = "{}_{}".format(name, tc),
374	                model = model,
375	                testcase = [tc],
376	                tags = tags,
377	                **tc_tests_kwargs
378	            )
379	            test_targets.append(":{}_{}".format(name, tc))
380	
381	    # Generate a meta-target for all tests.
382	    meta_target_kwargs = dict(all_tests_kwargs)
383	    tags = list(meta_target_kwargs.pop("tags", []))
384	    tags.append("manual")
385	    tags.append("verilator_cocotb_test_suite")

17	def _generate_linker_script_impl(ctx):
18	    """Implementation for the generate_linker_script rule."""
19	    output_script = ctx.outputs.out
20	    template = ctx.file.src
21	
22	    # Default ITCM size is 8KB, DTCM is 32KB.
23	    # From //hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu:Parameters.scala
24	    itcm_size_kbytes_default = 8
25	    dtcm_size_kbytes_default = 32
26	    dtcm_origin_default = "0x00010000"
27	    dtcm_origin_highmem = "0x00100000"
28	    dtcm_origin = dtcm_origin_default
29	    if ctx.attr.itcm_size_kbytes != itcm_size_kbytes_default or ctx.attr.dtcm_size_kbytes != dtcm_size_kbytes_default:
30	        dtcm_origin = dtcm_origin_highmem
31	
32	    stack_size_bytes_default = 128
33	    stack_size = ctx.attr.stack_size_bytes if ctx.attr.stack_size_bytes else stack_size_bytes_default
34	
35	    heap_location = ctx.attr.heap_location
36	    heap_size = ctx.attr.heap_size
37	
38	    # Logic to determine heap and stack sizing.
39	    # If heap is in DTCM and no size is specified, use the "remainder" logic.
40	    if heap_location == "DTCM" and (not heap_size or heap_size == "MAX"):
41	        heap_size_spec = ". = ORIGIN(DTCM) + LENGTH(DTCM) - STACK_SIZE;"
42	        stack_start_spec = "" # Just follows heap
43	    else:
44	        heap_size_spec = ". += {};".format(heap_size if heap_size else "1K")
45	        # Stack stays in DTCM, force it to the end to maximize space.
46	        stack_start_spec = ". = ORIGIN(DTCM) + LENGTH(DTCM) - STACK_SIZE;"
47	
48	    substitutions = {
49	        "@@ITCM_LENGTH@@": str(ctx.attr.itcm_size_kbytes),
50	        "@@DTCM_LENGTH@@": str(ctx.attr.dtcm_size_kbytes),
51	        "@@DTCM_ORIGIN@@": dtcm_origin,
52	        "@@STACK_SIZE@@": str(stack_size),
53	        "@@HEAP_LOCATION@@": heap_location,
54	        "@@HEAP_SIZE_SPEC@@": heap_size_spec,
55	        "@@STACK_START_SPEC@@": stack_start_spec,
56	    }
57	
58	    ctx.actions.expand_template(
59	        template = template,
60	        output = output_script,
61	        substitutions = substitutions,
62	    )

64	generate_linker_script = rule(
65	    implementation = _generate_linker_script_impl,

68	        "out": attr.output(mandatory = True),
69	        "itcm_size_kbytes": attr.int(mandatory = True),
70	        "dtcm_size_kbytes": attr.int(mandatory = True),
71	        "stack_size_bytes": attr.int(default = 128),
72	        "heap_size": attr.string(default = ""),
73	        "heap_location": attr.string(default = "DTCM"),

104	        feature_configuration = feature_configuration,
105	        name = ctx.label.name,

220	def coralnpu_v2_binary(
221	        name,
222	        srcs,
223	        tags = [],
224	        semihosting = False,
225	        itcm_size_kbytes = 8,
226	        dtcm_size_kbytes = 32,
227	        word_size = 32,
228	        linker_script = None,
229	        stack_size_bytes = 128,
230	        heap_size = "",
231	        heap_location = "DTCM",
232	        enable_vmem = True,
233	        **kwargs):
234	    """A helper macro for generating binary artifacts for the CoralNPU V2 core.
235	
236	    This macro uses the coralnpu_v2 toolchain, libgloss-htif,
237	    and a generated coralnpu linker script to build coralnpu binaries.
238	
239	    Args:
240	      name: The name of this rule.
241	      srcs: The c source files.
242	      tags: build tags.
243	      semihosting: Enable htif-style semihosting
244	      itcm_size_kbytes: Size of ITCM in KBytes.
245	      dtcm_size_kbytes: Size of DTCM in KBytes.
246	      stack_size_bytes: Size of stack in bytes.
247	      heap_size: Size of heap (e.g. "1K", "128M").
248	      heap_location: Memory region for heap ("DTCM", "EXTMEM", "DDR").
249	      enable_vmem: Whether to generate a VMEM file.
250	      **kwargs: Additional arguments forward to cc_binary.
251	    Emits rules:
252	      filegroup              named: <name>.bin
253	        Containing the binary output for the target.
254	      filegroup              named: <name>.elf
255	        Containing all elf output for the target.
256	    """
257	
258	    deps = kwargs.pop("deps", [])
259	    if semihosting:
260	        deps.append("//toolchain/crt:crt_semihosting")
261	    else:
262	        deps.append("//toolchain/crt")
263	
264	# See cache_size_param/hw/coralnpu/toolchain/BUILD.bazel for default linker script.
265	    if linker_script == None:
266	        _DEFAULT_ITCM_SIZE_KBYTES = 8
267	        _DEFAULT_DTCM_SIZE_KBYTES = 32
268	        _DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE_BYTES = 128
269	        _DEFAULT_HEAP_SIZE = ""
270	        _DEFAULT_HEAP_LOCATION = "DTCM"
271	
272	        linker_script_suffix = ""
273	        if itcm_size_kbytes != _DEFAULT_ITCM_SIZE_KBYTES or \
274	           dtcm_size_kbytes != _DEFAULT_DTCM_SIZE_KBYTES or \
275	           stack_size_bytes != _DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE_BYTES or \
276	           heap_size != _DEFAULT_HEAP_SIZE or \
277	           heap_location != _DEFAULT_HEAP_LOCATION:
278	            linker_script_suffix = "_ITCM%dKB_DTCM%dKB_STACK%d_HEAP%s%s" % (
279	                itcm_size_kbytes, dtcm_size_kbytes, stack_size_bytes, heap_size, heap_location)
280	
281	        linker_script_name = name + linker_script_suffix + "_linker_script"
282	        linker_script_output_file = name + linker_script_suffix + ".ld"
283	
284	        generate_linker_script(
285	            name = linker_script_name,
286	            src = "@coralnpu_hw//toolchain:coralnpu_tcm.ld.tpl",
287	            out = linker_script_output_file,
288	            itcm_size_kbytes = itcm_size_kbytes,
289	            dtcm_size_kbytes = dtcm_size_kbytes,
290	            stack_size_bytes = stack_size_bytes,
291	            heap_size = heap_size,
292	            heap_location = heap_location,
293	        )
294	        linker_script = ":" + linker_script_output_file
295	
296	    _coralnpu_v2_binary(
297	        name = name,
298	        srcs = srcs,
299	        linker_script = linker_script,
300	        semihosting = semihosting,
301	        tags = tags,
302	        deps = deps,
303	        word_size = word_size,
304	        enable_vmem = enable_vmem,
305	        **kwargs
306	    )
307	
308	    native.filegroup(
309	        name = "{}.elf".format(name),
310	        srcs = [name],
311	        output_group = "elf_file",
312	        tags = tags,
313	    )
314	
315	    native.filegroup(
316	        name = "{}.vmem".format(name),
317	        srcs = [name],
318	        output_group = "vmem_file",
319	        tags = tags,
320	    )
321	
322	    native.filegroup(
323	        name = "{}.bin".format(name),
324	        srcs = [name],
325	        output_group = "bin_file",
326	        tags = tags,
327	    )
